experiment: E46 (B-76 REVISED with PREREG change 7), P3, H5
H5: first-price asks let at least one owner gain by shading; per-item second price reduces that gain; posted price with Shapley sharing leaves no owner worse off than working alone (decision rules: PREREG change 7)
fleet: the p5 owner mix (A: CLV-1 + FLEX; B: Pegasus + Eagle; C: two HL-MAPP + two MoonFall), 30 % load, team-lift share 0.10, one year

rule_definitions.first: carriers are paid their ask; shippers pay the posted tariff per tonne-km
rule_definitions.second: carriers are paid the lowest competing ask for the same job (team jobs: the two lowest competing asks); the posted tariff is the reserve when no other free robot could carry it; shippers pay the posted tariff
rule_definitions.posted: carriers are paid the posted tariff per tonne-km, shippers pay it; the coalition's value is then shared by Shapley values (budget-neutral transfers)

k_note: one owner at a time scales its asks by k (the others truthful); under first and second price; posted price has no ask

message_loss.flag: design choice: perfect radio, so paired differences show incentives, not message-loss noise (P1 covers loss)

private_costs.true_cost: the engine's job_cost_usd (wear share 0.5 of unit cost per life hour + operator demand x operator_cost_per_h 1,000 USD/h) times the owner's multiplier eps_o
private_costs.eps_distribution: lognormal: eps_o = exp(N(0, sigma)), one draw per owner per seed (rng seeded by (46, seed)), the same in every run of that seed

sigma.sweep_note: declared range; the main run uses 0.2 (a sigma sweep needs new physical runs and is not part of E46)

private_costs.in_the_auction: an owner's bid = the marketplace bid + (eps_o x k_o - 1) x the carrier-cost part of it (dispatch._bid): the ask scales the cost the carrier names, not the shippers' value of time

shipper_value.what: value of delivery time by priority, Scenario.vot_usd_per_h (1: 5,000, 2: 1,000, 3: 100 USD/h) x completion time; undelivered items censored at the horizon

posted_price.how_earth_sets_it: cost recovery: Earth sets the tariff per tonne-km to the mean true carrier cost per tonne-km of the pooled market in the calibration seeds 101-110 (not the test seeds), per split, published before the year

coalitions: all non-empty subsets of {A, B, C}: singletons from the owners-alone run (A_MOON), pairs from pair-only runs (their vehicles and cargo, pooled C_AUCTION), the grand coalition from the pooled market
benchmark: O_ORACLE (the marketplace with full information) for the efficiency loss
